official_recipe_topologies_observed: TP4 (GB300 tray, FP8, for largest KV cache)
topology.note: TP4 in the official recipe is used for maximizing KV-cache pool size on a specific tray configuration (GB300), NOT because TP4 is required to serve the base model at all -- per phase instruction, TP4 must not be inferred as mandatory merely because one official recipe variant uses it. The historical 1x H200 BF16 load result strongly suggests a single-GPU (TP1) production-serving smoke is a realistic minimum qualification topology, since the full weight set already fits on one H200 with substantial VRAM headroom (H200 has 141 GiB; historical weight usage was ~55 GB).
